summary: Enhance your recruitment skills with our Diversity and Inclusion Training Course. Learn to create equitable hiring practices that attract diverse talent.
lede: Inclusive recruitment training helps HR professionals, talent acquisition specialists, and hiring managers make hiring processes fairer and more consistent. It covers identifying unconscious bias, writing inclusive job adverts and reaching broader candidate groups, then applying structured interviews and competency-based scoring to assess applicants. It also addresses inclusive onboarding and ways to support belonging after hiring.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or influence hiring and staffing decisions, ensuring their processes are inclusive and equitable.
audience: Consultants and trainers in HR and leadership
modules: Understanding Diversity and Inclusion in Recruitment
Building Inclusive Job Descriptions and Adverts
Building a Culture of Belonging and Accountability
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of HR practices and a commitment to fostering diversity and inclusion in their organizations.
